summary: Full semantic review and corrections complete; current charts/configuration, monetary calculations, policies, rightsizing workflow and quiz verified.
findings: Replaced stale OpenCost/Kubecost2 configuration with rendered current charts; corrected repository, values nesting, ServiceAccount identity and model architecture.
Separated CUR source from Athena result buckets; current CUR2 delivery service, scoped IRSA, BPA, SSE-S3 and explicit Glue prerequisites.
Distinguished model rates, calendar window cost, billing and projections; removed fabricated metrics and annotation-to-number PromQL.
Implemented Decimal cent-conserving shared/idle allocation with retained unattributed costs and explicit synthetic results.
Replaced unusable report image/shell snippets with tested stdlib Python, actual calendar periods, NoData errors, typed budgets, correct Cron timezone and optional Slack delivery.
Replaced inaccurate automatic PR claim with tested container-name-matched review proposals and null billing savings.
Migrated new cost policies to current CEL ValidatingPolicy; tested Pod, sidecar, Deployment, CronJob and namespace exclusion.
Clarified dashboard filtering is not authorization, anomaly SERVICE scope, EMAIL/SNS frequency, delayed budget actions and 12-month historical tag backfill.
Reviewed/rebuilt six diagrams, replaced unsupported maturity timelines and unexplained allocation numbers; updated both eight-question quizzes.
